sources.title: README.md · magnitudedev/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-NVFP4-GGUF at main
sources.snippet: NVFP4 GGUF of nvidia/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-NVFP4 for use with Magnitude. The routed experts are NVIDIA's NVFP4 weights repacked bit for bit, with their per-expert second-level scales; the other projections are Q8_0 or Q6_K, the n-gram table Q8_0.

sources.title: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next NVFP4 (109 GB, single-GPU vLLM) - GitHub
sources.snippet: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next is a 335 GB model. This is a 109 GB NVFP4 quantization of it that runs through vLLM on a single 121 GB GPU (built and tested on an NVIDIA DGX Spark, GB10/sm121).
